examples.scenario: Raw Int16 value 1234 has scale 0.01 and offset -5
examples.reason: The accepted physical value is 7.34 in the declared unit; the raw integer is not itself a height.
NoData comparison occurs in the raw domain rather than against -327.68 after decoding.

examples.scenario: Decoded elevation is written back to Int16
examples.reason: Fractional metre information and range may be lost unless an adequate floating type is used.

examples.scenario: Mask marks a plausible value of 42.1 as invalid
examples.reason: Validity is controlled by the mask even when the number appears plausible.

examples.scenario: Approximate overview statistics report a maximum lower than the native raster
examples.reason: Overview or subset statistics cannot certify parcel height difference.

examples.scenario: A VRT applies scale and selects a different source band
examples.reason: The displayed file path alone does not identify the value-producing chain.

examples.scenario: GeoTIFF has OSGB horizontal CRS but no vertical CRS or product-unit evidence
examples.reason: Horizontal location does not identify elevation datum or unit.

examples.scenario: Vertical axis is depth-positive-down in metres
examples.reason: Matching units do not make opposite axis direction semantically equivalent.
